title: Date, announced time, and purpose
publicText: Civic Hall announced the January 30, 2016 gathering for 1-3 p.m. and described its constituent-services focus.
qualification: The time window was announced in advance; it does not prove the event's actual duration. The Wayback page preserves an embedded social feed and is not the event listing.

title: CouncilStat framing and Civic Hall venue
publicText: New York City Council's event-day post from Civic Hall described the gathering as its first CouncilStat hackathon.
qualification: The Council's attributed CouncilStat wording does not establish that this was its first civic-data event of every kind.

title: Independent CallNYC follow-on and press coverage
publicText: Politico New York's March 2016 coverage, the public repository, and the archived project surface document Jamie's independent follow-on development of CallNYC.
qualification: CallNYC was not an official Council product or established formal hackathon submission and is not current civic guidance.

title: Recovered event branding
publicText: The Council-branded promotional graphic used the wording 'New York City Council Hackathon.'
qualification: This supports recovered branding, not a longer formal registration title.

title: Bounded Civic Hall archive search
